indexes.//: onMatchCompletedMatchdayBonus (functions/groupAwards.js) — counts the day's real matches inside a +/- window. Without this the query throws FAILED_PRECONDITION on every score submission and the Matchday bonus never pays.

weeklyReminders (functions/notifications.js) — finds challenges opened in the last 7 days for the ladder-allowance reset. Without this the scheduled job throws after sending the digest, so ladder_challenges_reset never fires.
